invariants.rationale: The method always instantiates and initializes a new Json object, assigning it to 'json' and returning it as 'result'.
The method calls json.setSerializer(Skin.class, ...), so a serializer for Skin.class will be registered in 'result'.
The method calls json.setSerializer(BitmapFont.class, ...), so a serializer for BitmapFont.class will be registered in 'result'.
The method sets a serializer for Color.class, so it's expected to be present in the result.
The method sets a serializer for TintedDrawable.class, so it must be present in the result on return.
